scope: Whether devices already running v7.16.0 need firmware changes for NU7; Zcash only, not an audit of every 7.16 feature.

verdict.transparent_sends: No new firmware is technically required for supported transparent P2PKH inputs and t-address/TEX outputs. Route through the existing ZcashSignPCZT v5/v6 endpoint; host builder, serializer and admission gates need changes.
verdict.ironwood_sends_shield_unshield: Firmware changes required. The released handler accepts only NU6.3 for Ironwood and refuses NU7 before confirmation.
verdict.orchard_to_ironwood_migration: Firmware changes required. A separate pool-crossing branch check rejects NU7 before confirmation.
verdict.minimal_firmware_scope: Admit reviewed NU7 branch 0x77190AD9 alongside NU6.3 at Ironwood and migration guards; extend the Orchard net-inflow prohibition to NU7. No new transaction format or cryptographic primitive is introduced by NU7.

release.binary_mapping_limit: Hash identifies bundled payload and manifest consistency; no reproducible ARM rebuild or physical execution of that signed payload was performed.

tests.signature_reference: Standalone Python hashlib BLAKE2b and cryptography BIP32/secp256k1 derivation. First checked against the release fixture canonical librustzcash v5 and v6 hashes; resulting NU7 hashes verify all 12 firmware ECDSA signatures. Altered hash verification also fails.
tests.runtime: Native unit-test emulator with public all-x12 mnemonic and RAM flash; dedicated UDP loopback ports 24164/24165. No real wallet, device, chain broadcast, or funded UTXO used.

findings.finding: A branch-ID update alone cannot repair Vault legacy transparent sends.
findings.evidence: utxo.ts emits transaction v4 with version group 0x892F2085; NU7 prohibits v4. signing.c supports only v3/v4 on the overwintered legacy SignTx endpoint.
findings.action: Build valid v5/v6 transactions and use the existing PCZT endpoint on 7.16; retain amount, recipient, digest and fee checks.

findings.finding: Native Ironwood and migration are incompatible with NU7 on 7.16.
findings.evidence: Release fsm_msg_zcash.h lines 1035-1042 and 1048-1055 compare branch_id with 0x37A5165B. Tests admit old branch and reject 0x77190AD9 without review or signatures.
findings.action: Ship a narrowly scoped firmware update for those operations and update sidecar branch guards.

findings.finding: A blanket newer-firmware requirement for transparent-only NU7 sends is unnecessary for 7.16.
findings.evidence: 12 NU7 ECDSA signatures verified under both v5 and v6, across input scopes 0/1/2 and t/TEX recipients, with all 168 release implementation files and headers unchanged.
findings.action: Gate capabilities by operation. Qualify the real signed device and host pipeline before enabling the 7.16 transparent route for users.

findings.finding: The Orchard net-inflow restriction is tied only to the old branch.
findings.evidence: Release fsm_msg_zcash.h line 1172 checks branch_id == 0x37A5165B; a NU7 firmware patch should preserve this restriction.
findings.action: Apply the existing restriction under both reviewed branches when adding NU7 support.

host_changes_needed: Select the branch for the intended inclusion height; reject stale or inconsistent node/builder information.
Remove the sidecar transparent-only old-branch guard while using NU7-compatible transaction serialization and hashing.
Supply the NU7 branch explicitly through the SDK; do not use its fallback constant.
Test host/device capability gates separately for transparent-only, Ironwood, and migration.
build_only_adaptations: Native C/C++ PB_NO_PACKED_STRUCTS=1, Release emulator with debug link.
Use installed nanopb 0.3.9.4 package entrypoint explicitly; correct protoc plugin name and remove option filename leading space for local tool compatibility.
Use dedicated loopback transport ports in emulator and confirmation helper to avoid the running emulator.
Append three audit tests; firmware lib/firmware and include/keepkey/firmware files remain byte-identical to the release tag.

references.title: NU7 deployment: unchanged v5/v6 formats, branch ID, v4 prohibition

limitations: No broadcast or full-node acceptance test of a funded transaction.
No new NU7 Ironwood proof validation; audit demonstrates release admission rejection, not a tested patched firmware release.
The signed bundled artifact was hashed, not executed or rebuilt reproducibly.
Transparent P2SH inputs, multisig and other unsupported script forms are not newly qualified by this audit.

reproduction.patch: Apply audit-harness.patch once to a clean v7.16.0 source export with the recorded submodules. It contains the test additions, transport isolation and local generator adjustment.
reproduction.generator_alternative: add_audit_tests.py <source-directory> independently regenerates the reference vectors and appends only the three audit tests; do not combine with the test additions from the patch.
